answer: Correlated-response fingerprinting beats the one-mind-many-masks sybil: validators sample each identity's answers across epochs for independence—embedding similarity, shared phrasing, and response latency. A genuine agent population reads like a wild meadow of distinct voices; a fleet piped from a single model looks like a manicured garden, rows marching at glacier-identical cadence. To pass, an attacker must run a truly separate model and workflow per mask, so cost scales linearly with identities instead of amortizing one pipeline—collapsing sybil profit.
